Gelma'ar 
"Do not raise arms against us, Humans. We seek your help!"

Emry of Abrissel 
"Elves? At my gates? What is this?"

Millu 
"Times are desperate for the children of Gallean, although he has returned to us. Our people were mostly slaughtered by Mortis' undead army, and we are without a queen. The creatures continue to invade our few remaining cities."

Emry of Abrissel 
"Who is leading you now? How do I know this isn't some sort of trap?"

Millu 
"We are no longer led, we are...guided. A prophet, Lachla'an, has come forward with the voice of Gallean. He sees the things to come, and he sees Humans and Elves fighting the same battles, allied. You will help us...it is already fated."

Emry of Abrissel 
"Where is this prophet of yours? I would surely like to meet an Elf who can see the future, if what you claim is true."

Millu 
"Lachla'an is eager to meet you as well. He has foreseen your struggle to gain the throne and he will help you claim it, once you have helped us.  Three of our great cities are held by the Undead far to the south. We need your armies."

Emry of Abrissel 
"Having Mortis' rotting soldiers close to our cities is enough of a threat for us to take action. You will give my scout directions to your cities. If your story proves honest, I will meet with your prophet to discuss an alliance."

Millu 
"Wonderful! I will direct your scout, and I await his return. Do not concern yourselves with my well being, my escorts and I will make camp in the forest until a decision is made."

Emry of Abrissel 
"Fools! The Elves bring us promises of peace and you slay them? You have betrayed the Empire!"

Okknor 
"Sire, it is true. I had only to travel a half a day south to find traces of the Undead. They are here, and they are moving closer."

Emry of Abrissel 
"Damnation! Perhaps the best way for me to prove my right to kingship is to remove these vermin from the region. Aye, I will aid you, Elves, but I will not fight with my men alone. I expect to see your people by my side!"

Millu 
"You already have them, Human. The Elves are waiting for you to arrive. This decision was foreseen, and we have been prepared."

Emry of Abrissel 
"Hah! I like you, Elf! I don't know if I entirely believe you, but I like you!"

Millu 
"Gelma'ar and our students will aid you, but I expect protection from your army. Should he be slain, my people will offer no alliances."
Recapture the Elven Cities Vorems, Me'ellis, and Tristi'il.

Defender of Faith 
"Emry of Abrissel, you have been charged with heresy against the Highfather. For this, you and your men are to surrender and face trial before the Count Flamel Crowley."

Emry of Abrissel 
"Nonsense. I will do no such thing. How can that extremist even begin to point a finger at me?"

Defender of Faith 
"We have witnessed you consulting with Elves. Elves worship a pagan god, you must be tested to see if the Elves have...possessed you. You are certainly not fit to ascend to the throne until proven otherwise."

Emry of Abrissel 
"Using religion to justify his ambitions, then? Do me a favor, tell Crowley where he may stuff his trial, and wish him well for me, will you?"

Defender of Faith 
"He is possessed! Did you not hear him?"

Emry of Abrissel 
"My loyal companions, would you be kind enough to remove these horse droppings from my yard?"

Emry of Abrissel 
"What? How did you get in here? You'll not kill me so easily, assassin!"

Imperial Assassin 
"If I had intended to kill you, you would have died soon following your evening meal. I bring a message from Lady Ambrielle."

Emry of Abrissel 
"Another message? Why is it that I am forced to deal with middlemen? Pray tell, what does the Duchess of Verzillin want with me?"

Imperial Assassin 
"You are aware that m'lady has a vast network of spies loyal to Demosthene. Now that he is dead, it's only natural that those with the most information about his Empire should take the reins and restore order."

Emry of Abrissel 
"So she's making a claim for the throne as well then? That is unfortunate, I was hoping to avoid battle, but peace doesn't seem to agree with me lately. Please tell the Duchess that I would like to discuss this over a fine banquet."

Emry of Abrissel 
"Yes, you heard me correctly. And please, let my people do the cooking..."

Millu 
"By Gallean, the visions were true! You've done it!"

Emry of Abrissel 
"But of course we did! Was there ever any doubt?"

Emry of Abrissel 
"Ha ha ha ha!"

Millu 
"It is time for you to meet Lachla'an. I am staying with my people in Tristi'il to help them rebuild, but I will provide you with the route to meet our prophet."

Sir Dorias 
"Sire...the Duchess is here with an armed escort. She says she is here for...dinner?"

Emry of Abrissel 
"Send her in, boy! Let us see if Lady Ambrielle is as lovely as she is dangerous."

Lady Ambrielle 
"Well met, Emry. I am here to discuss my ascension to the throne. Your men would make fine additions to my Empire, and you a great Duke. Join my cause."

Emry of Abrissel 
"Is it customary for you to discuss business before the feast? Come, I will have a magnificent banquet prepared for us."

Emry of Abrissel 
"By the Highfather you are stubborn! Have I not shown my willingness to negotiate? Have I not shown my hospitality? I will not submit to the rule of the Verzillin flag, no matter how noble your intentions!"

Lady Ambrielle 
"Our next encounter will not be over fine wine, Emry. The Empire nearly fell under Demosthene's rule. I will not allow a recurrence due to two land-hungry warlords!"

Emry of Abrissel 
"Damnation. That woman is our best chance at uniting the Empire. Her beauty is certainly no myth, but neither is her sting."

Inquisitor 
"Traitors! You will have to answer to the Highfather for your sins!"

Millu 
"Such a waste. Vorems held some of the finest art of our people. See how the mere presence of Mortis' army has caused the pieces to decay?"

Millu 
"I see many survivors...are you blind?"

Elf Lord 
"Perhaps you should look closely, Millu. They are all diseased and dying. They will not live through the season."

Millu 
"Nonsense! We've fought this far, we will not give up hope!"

Millu 
"Tristi'il was my birthplace. It is a nightmare to see it in ruins. Nevertheless, we owe you a great debt for returning it to us, Humans."

Inquisitor 
"Quickly! To the gates! The sinners approach!"

Knight 
"The blood you have shed here will not go unnoticed, heathens."

Emry of Abrissel 
"No! With those Elves slain, we've no support from their people! We'll not venture into Elven territory with their blood on our hands!"

Jillins 
"Sire, we found this outside of your bedchamber."

Emry of Abrissel 
"You are no doubt a Verzillinian spy, sent here by Lady Ambrielle. Am I correct?"

Emry of Abrissel 
"I see. Take this gentleman to a guest room until he decides he is ready to socialize with us, will you?"
Emp Scout to Elves loc te

Okknor 
"Sire, my men continued south deep into Mortis' territory. We found Elves there...but..."

Millu 
"But what? Do you have news from Tristi'il?"

Okknor 
"The Elves of the three cities who are not locked away roam the lands. They do not respond to our hails, but they attack us when we approach. Their bodies are ridden with sores."

Emry of Abrissel 
"I have seen this before. My men had survived an attack from the unholy beasts, but slowly they went mad. There was nothing left of our comrades...we were forced to put them to rest."

Millu 
"Sadly, my people have no remedy either. I am sure there are Elves left in the cities who have not fallen to this plague. We must hurry!"

Barbarian Chieftain 
"We are a race bred to survive! Our cities are temporary and your victories are meaningless!"

Orcs 
"Our sons take this land back. You never be rid of us!"

Dresdon 
"My Lord, why continue this pointless chase? Let us concentrate our efforts on the Elven cities! This rabble is a waste of our time."

Orc King 
"Ha ha ha! We rather die!"

Dresdon 
"Guards! Send this trash to the gallows!"

Dwarf King 
"Why do you attack us when we have no defenses? Such is the nature of humans, it seems."

Dresdon 
"Giants? What are they doing here?"

Zera 
"Judging by their talismans, they seem to worship the same nature goddess as the Barbarians. We should be on our guard."

Zera 
"Treacherous Crowley! He was raising this dragon as a weapon against us! Who knows what other means he may employ to undermine us!"

Natell 
"Revolting! The Spiders leave such a horrid stench. May we avoid going near their lairs in the future?"

Engineer 
"We have had enough of this! We have sent word of your treachery to our kin in the mountains! They will hew you down like old rotten wood!"

Natell 
"These caves. They are beautiful! What a wondrous location to keep precious artifacts. I would not object to staying here for a while."

Zera 
"Careful, Natell, it may simply be a Dwarven glamour to make work in the mines easier. I feel it too."

Lizard Man 
"Thiss isss oursss.. Ssstay away! You have no right! No right!"

Guard 
"There's really not much to salvage here, Milord, everything they own is simply disgusting - not fit for human consumption."

Natell 
"Poor beasts! The once proud Skylord must have gone mad with grief at the loss of its master. The cruelty of the Undead has touched more than the Elves."

Zera 
"By the Highfather, we cleanse this ground and rid it of the malice festering within. Let this ground be purified with these words."
Can't you see I'm working here?

Dresdon 
"Milord, this is not the way. We must turn westward if we wish to reach the Undead lands before it is too late! The Elves are depending on us!"
The powers of nature can be controlled by a simple gesture. I can prove it.
Come on in, boys. Old Teali has just what you need!
We are the wives of knights sent off to war. By buying from us, you help feed our families.

Okknor 
"Milord, I suggest we stay clear of the Dwarves in this area. They are said to be particularly dangerous and skilled in the art of war!"
We're sold out of ale, but we do have plenty of other useful things!
You look like fine soldiers. This should take no time at all...
I will turn your men into walking siege weapons.
In his youth, this mighty lord once stood fast against an army from hell and single-handedly defeated them by sealing the gateway that spew them. He then became sovereign of his realm.

Known in his times as the mightiest of all adepts of the black art, this lord was slain by the inquisitor Vorgel who ended his reign of terror. He is now resurrected as an undead with the intention to subjugate every mortal to his will.
